mapper.select:
/* 프로그램 사용 이력관리 (7022) */ /* AdminLogProgramMapper.selectList */
SELECT A.AI_INPT_PGM_USG_HST_NO, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_USER_NO, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_URL_NM, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_IPAD, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_MCHR_NM, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_SCRN_NO, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_FLD_CD, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_ACTI_CD, A.AI_INPT_CNCT_PARM_TXT, A.TRN_LOG_SRNO, A.LST_DB_CHG_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(SUBSTR(A.AI_INPT_PGM_USG_HST_NO,1,14),'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'),'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LST_DB_CHG_DTM, (SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_CNCT_USER_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) AS AI_INPT_CNCT_USER_NM, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '700' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_CNCT_FLD_CD) AS AI_INPT_CNCT_FLD_NM, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '701' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_CNCT_ACTI_CD) AS AI_INPT_CNCT_ACTI_NM, ( SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '165' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_CNCT_SCRN_NO ) AS AI_INPT_CNCT_SCRN_NM FROM CSPD811TH A WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_SCRN_NO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_SCRN_NO DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_FLD_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_FLD_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_ACTI_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_ACTI_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_USER_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY LST_DB_CHG_DTM
ORDER BY LST_DB_CHG_DTM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_IPAD
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_IPAD DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_URL_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_URL_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_PARM_TXT
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_PARM_TXT DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_MCHR_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_CNCT_MCHR_NM DESC
ORDER BY LST_DB_CHG_DTM DESC

/* AdminLogProgramMapper.selectTrnLogSrno */ SELECT SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6'), 1, 8) || #{userId} || SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSTIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISSFF6'), 9, 20) || LPAD(ROUND(DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE(1, 20)), 2, 0) AS TRN_LOG_SRNO FROM DUAL

if.test: schSdate1 != null and schSdate1 != '' and schEdate1 != null and schEdate1 != ''

sql.if: AND AI_INPT_PGM_USG_HST_NO BETWEEN REPLACE(#{schSdate1},'-','') || '000000000000' AND REPLACE(#{schEdate1},'-','') || '999999999999'
